excerpt: Long Term Benefit Trust: We will regularly brief the LTBT on plans and developments related to our Risk Reports, including model training, capability evals, mitigations, and risk analyses.
paraphrase: Anthropic will regularly update the Long Term Benefit Trust on Risk Report-related plans and developments.

excerpt: Internal transparency: We will share final, unredacted Risk Reports with Anthropic's regular-clearance staff.
paraphrase: Anthropic will share complete, unredacted Risk Reports with regular-clearance staff.

excerpt: Noncompliance reporting: We will maintain a process for Anthropic staff to submit anonymous or identified reports regarding potential noncompliance with this policy.
paraphrase: Anthropic will maintain a process allowing staff to submit anonymous or identified noncompliance reports.

excerpt: Staff will have more than one option for who receives these reports, including the RSO, and at least one executive who does not report to the RSO.
paraphrase: Staff have multiple reporting recipient options, including the RSO and an executive independent of the RSO.

excerpt: When we receive a report, we will promptly investigate, take appropriate and proportional corrective action if it is substantiated, and document the report and our findings.
paraphrase: Received reports will be promptly investigated, corrective action taken if substantiated, and findings documented.

excerpt: We will provide quarterly updates to the Board regarding reports of potential noncompliance, whether substantiated or not.
paraphrase: The Board receives quarterly updates on noncompliance reports regardless of substantiation status.

excerpt: If we determine that a report is (1) substantiated and (2) involves a material safety risk, we will promptly notify the Board and we may provide public notice of the same.
paraphrase: Substantiated reports involving material safety risk trigger prompt Board notification and possible public disclosure.

excerpt: Finally, we will protect reporters from retaliation, and where a report concerns the conduct of the RSO, at least one recipient will be a member of the Board.
paraphrase: Reporters are protected from retaliation, and reports about the RSO must include a Board member as a recipient.

excerpt: Employee agreements: We will not impose contractual non-disparagement obligations on employees, candidates, or former employees in a way that could impede or discourage them from publicly raising safety concerns about Anthropic.
paraphrase: Anthropic commits not to use non-disparagement clauses that would discourage employees from raising safety concerns.
